title: Qwen3.8-27B unsloth GGUF on llama.cpp (24 GB card or Mac)
slug_note: Dynamic UD quants from IQ1_S to BF16 put the 27B on a 24 GB card or a Mac.

variation.quant_detail: Dynamic UD quants; size shown is the Q4-class representative
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama.cpp with CUDA or Metal, Q4_K_M or smaller to stay on-card

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 34.9 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Resident estimate from the quant size plus KV headroom.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp for your operating system using the model card's macOS/Linux, Windows, prebuilt-binary or source-build instructions.
Use a llama.cpp build at ece963f41 (~b10450) or newer with Flash Attention enabled; older CUDA build 221f0f6 silently corrupts output.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (676-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write an LRU cache module with tests (79-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on a cold 4705-token prompt
drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)

caveats: No numbers yet; pick the quant by your VRAM, not by the benchmark tables.
At IQ1_S the 27B fits almost anywhere but quality cost is real.

CUDA build trap: llama.cpp @221f0f6 silently corrupts this model's output (loads fine, full speed, garbage completions); use ece963f41 (~b10450) or newer with Flash Attention on. Negative result documented in the tools/history pass-4 ledger ([9]).

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama serve -hf unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_M` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 30 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 34.9 GiB (weights + KV at llama.cpp's default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens on this build)).
